value.0: Chef Master Yu runs the Tapani Delights from the kitchens, and his cullinary expertise is considered legendary in the sector.
Chef Master Yu's fame and reputation has drawn a small legion of those willing to work the harsh hours needed to impress him, all with hopes of becoming one of his apprentices.
Pho Yu runs Tapani Delights with her husband, and her only weakness is having her taxes audited. She avoids that with great care and cunning.

Czerka Corporation is a massive, galaxy spanning corporate entity which engages in all manner of business, especially anything to do with war. They are highly controversial, especially as many of their major holdings are in space now controlled by the Sith Empire. While this has received some attention by the Republic Senate, Czerka has not received sanctions for continued business there, assuring the galaxy they are careful to comply with all sanctions on Darth Malaks empire and do not supply enemy forces.
This appears to be the uniform of a Czerka Corporation employee.
The Rodian before you is dressed in beautiful blue attire. In her hand is a holo puck, with imagery of star ships. She casually flips through them as he idly waits in the Hall.

This ugnaught seems constantly working on something. Dressed in a sleek black flame retardant suit, and a stunning dusters hat, she is just about ready to build anything. 

On her data pad are blueprints of all different kinds of structures, and furniture alike.

The Jal Shey were an ancient order of users who studied the Force from a purely intellectual perspective, forsaking the more spiritual paths taken by the Jedi and Sith. Jal Shey were typically more known for diplomacy, on par with the greatest Jedi negotiators, but, unlike the Jedi and Sith, they were less successful in physical pursuits, even where the Force was involved. The Jal Shey were also a nomadic group, traveling the galaxy in search of new locations to study the Force, and they were particularly selective about recruiting new members.

Because they lacked the physical abilities of the Jedi, Jal Shey members often wore various types of armor to protect themselves. They also created other devices such as Jal Shey meditation gloves and Jal Shey belts to further augment their physical abilities, imbuing them with the Force.
